description:
Redirects links to the right browser or browser profile based on your rules.

Browser Wrangler registers as a browser in Windows and routes clicked links
to the browser and profile you choose, based on URL matching rules.
Supports multiple browsers and profiles, a picker for ambiguous links,
regex rules, and per-profile visibility. A .NET/WinUI 3 re-imagining of
Browser Tamer.
